local function EROYJB_fake_script() -- TextButton3.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', TextButton3)

	local button = script.Parent
	local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
	local character
	local humanoid
	local flying = false
	local speed = 60
	
	-- Função que cria o BodyVelocity para voar
	local function startFlying()
		character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlightVelocity"
		bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
		bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		bv.Parent = root
	
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	end
	
	-- Função que remove o voo
	local function stopFlying()
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local bv = root:FindFirstChild("FlightVelocity")
		if bv then
			bv:Destroy()
		end
	
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
	
	-- Botão clicado
	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		flying = not flying
	
		if flying then
			startFlying()
			button.Text = "Parar"
		else
			stopFlying()
			button.Text = "Voar"
		end
	end)
	
	-- Movimento no voo
	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if flying then
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local bv = root:FindFirstChild("FlightVelocity")
	
			if bv then
				local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local direction = Vector3.zero
	
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
					direction = direction + cam.CFrame.LookVector
				end
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
					direction = direction - cam.CFrame.LookVector
				end
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
					direction = direction - cam.CFrame.RightVector
				end
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
					direction = direction + cam.CFrame.RightVector
				end
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
					direction = direction + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				end
				if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
					direction = direction - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				end
	
				bv.Velocity = direction * speed
			end
		end
	end)
	
end
coroutine.wrap(EROYJB_fake_script)()
